summary: You add the third endpoint, /api/extract: ask a fake model for JSON, check the reply with Pydantic, and answer 400 for blank text or 502 for a bad reply. Then you write five tests, a README and push the project to GitHub.
goal: Ship three tested endpoints with a fake LLM, a README and the code on GitHub.

items.text: Answer the two warm-up questions from memory, then read the contract
Part A: write extractor.py and make FakeLlmClient return a fixed reply, then see mypy say Success
Part B: write POST /api/extract and match the 200 response, then get a 400 for blank text
Part C: write five tests and see 5 passed
Part D: write the README and run its commands in a fresh terminal
Part E: commit, push to GitHub and see your README on the repository page
Play the Lab Referee game to the end and see your score
